reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a partially filled horizontal battery. While partial battery glyphs often come from UI status bars, in a task list this serves well as the standard icon for buying, charging, testing, or recycling batteries and power banks. It is only weakly ambiguous with other battery fill-state variants.
